tracks.title: The GPS Has Trust Issues
tracks.prompt: Original comedic country-rock song with believable warm male country baritone, relaxed Southern delivery, natural phrasing, slight gravel, acoustic guitar, bright electric guitar, bass, live drums, light fiddle, restrained organ, playful harmonies, polished radio-ready production and a huge memorable chorus. Human-sounding breath and timing. No imitation of any named artist.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The lady in the dashboard said
Turn left where there ain't a road
I said, ma'am, that's somebody's cornfield
She said, recalculating mode

Now she's sighing at my choices
Like she pays the monthly note
Every mile she sounds less certain
Every bridge becomes a vote

[Pre-Chorus]
She knows every road in three whole states
Still don't trust the way I drive

[Chorus]
My GPS has trust issues
She says turn, I say we'll see
She's got satellites above us
Still keeps second-guessing me
She can find a coffee shop
From a county line away
But if I take one little shortcut
She gets personal all day

[Verse 2]
JakeAI is riding shotgun
Said the route is technically sound
Then the GPS said make a U-turn
On a road that circles town

I said somebody here's confused
They both replied, not me
So I pulled into a gas station
And asked a guy named Steve

[Bridge]
Steve said, keep going till the water tower
Then ignore the screen
I said, finally, an interface
That tells me what it means

[Final Chorus]
My GPS has trust issues
She says turn, I say we'll see
She's got satellites above us
Still keeps second-guessing me
When she says recalculating
I can hear the judgment too
But we always get there eventually
Which is more than I can say for you

tracks.title: After Hours Department
tracks.prompt: Original electro-soul and midnight-pop song with warm smoky female contralto, intimate conversational phrasing, understated confidence, soft grit on sustained notes, round electric bass, dry pocket drums, Rhodes-style keys, muted guitar, analog synth glow, restrained electronic percussion and tasteful chorus harmonies. No imitation of any named artist.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The building changed its breathing
When the elevators stopped
Someone left the hallway glowing
Someone never turned it off

There are notes beside the coffee
There are plans beneath the chair
Every problem gets more honest
When nobody else is there

[Chorus]
Welcome to the after hours department
Where the clocks don't make the rules
We repair the little futures
Everybody else forgot to use
No reception at the front desk
No committee in the hall
If it breaks after midnight
We were probably here before the call

[Verse 2]
Blue light on the window
Street is quiet underneath
Every screen is holding secrets
Every fan is moving heat

There's a calm inside the humming
There's a rhythm in the mess
When the whole world stops requesting
You can hear the system guess

[Bridge]
Leave a message
Leave the light
We'll get to it
Not tonight
Maybe tonight

[Final Chorus]
Welcome to the after hours department
Where the clocks don't make the rules
We repair the little futures
Everybody else forgot to use
No reception at the front desk
No committee in the hall
If it breaks after midnight
We were probably here before the call

tracks.title: Temporary Permanent Fix
tracks.prompt: Original hard rock song with convincing male rock tenor, controlled rasp, two electric guitars, bass, live drums, occasional analog synth texture, punchy verses and a large double-tracked chorus. Energetic but not screamed. No imitation of any named band or vocalist.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Zip tie on the bracket
Tape across the seam
Somebody wrote temporary
Back in 2019

Every warning label faded
Every shortcut learned to stay
If the thing survives till Friday
Friday somehow moves away

[Chorus]
It's a temporary permanent fix
Good enough to hold the bricks
Nobody touch it, nobody breathe
We finally got the light to stay green
Temporary permanent fix
Built from luck and borrowed bits
If it works, don't ask me why
Just write it down and walk on by

[Verse 2]
There are bolts we shouldn't tighten
There are wires we shouldn't know
There are three approved procedures
And the one that makes it go

Every clean diagram is lying
Every real machine has scars
You can keep your perfect answer
We'll be underneath the bars

[Bridge]
Hold it
Hit it
Power cycle
Wait
Good enough
Ship it
Mark it done
Too late

[Final Chorus]
It's a temporary permanent fix
Good enough to hold the bricks
Nobody touch it, nobody breathe
We finally got the light to stay green
Temporary permanent fix
Built from luck and borrowed bits
If it works, don't ask me why
Just write it down and walk on by

tracks.title: Sunrise Was Not Approved
tracks.prompt: Original cinematic electronic synthwave track with a distinct synthetic female-to-androgynous lead vocalist, cool restrained verses, clear diction, intimate close-mic tone, deep sub bass, crisp modern drums, dark arpeggiated synths, wide pads, glitch accents and a powerful layered chorus. No imitation of any named artist.
tracks.lyrics:
[Intro]
Blue screen
Black room
One more hour
Came too soon

[Verse 1]
We were still inside the problem
When the windows started gold
No one filed a change request
For the morning to unfold

Every cursor kept on blinking
Every fan refused to stop
Then the skyline changed the lighting
Like somebody hit deploy

[Chorus]
Sunrise was not approved
Nobody signed the form
We were not done with the darkness
We were not prepared for warm
Sunrise was not approved
But here it comes again
Turning every hidden failure
Into something we can mend

[Verse 2]
Coffee tastes like consequence
Hallway smells like rain
All the things we swore were finished
Opened up again

[Bridge]
No rollback
No delay
Daylight shipped itself today

[Final Chorus]
Sunrise was not approved
Nobody signed the form
We were not done with the darkness
We were not prepared for warm
Sunrise was not approved
But here it comes again
Turning every hidden failure
Into something we can mend

tracks.title: Human Resources Is Offline

Emotionally curious rather than threatening. No copyrighted samples or imitation of known robot voices.
tracks.lyrics:

Ticket routed
Department unavailable
Continuing without guidance

[Verse 1]
I had a question
Form said wait
Office hours
Ended at eight
I sent a message
Marked urgent low
System replied
We do not know

[Chorus]
Human Resources is offline
Please enjoy the hold music tone
Your concern is very important
To a mailbox left alone
Human Resources is offline
No representative in sight

But the timestamp looks polite

Policy document
Version three
Contradicts
Version B
Manager field
Blank again
I have copied
No one in

[Breakdown]
Please remain calm
Please remain queued
Please remain employed
Status: unresolved

[Final Chorus]
Human Resources is offline
Please enjoy the hold music tone
Your concern is very important
To a mailbox left alone
Human Resources is offline
No representative in sight
I have escalated nothing

Case closed automatically

tracks.title: Streetlights Don't Ask Questions
tracks.prompt: Original late-night alternative dream-pop song with believable intimate female alto, soft breathy edges, restrained live drums, warm bass guitar, chiming guitar, analog synths, ambient texture and tasteful layered harmonies. Slightly strange but emotionally human. No imitation of any named artist.
tracks.lyrics:
[Verse 1]
We took the long way home again
Past the warehouse and the rain
Every window held a color
Every road forgot its name

Nothing asked us where we'd been
Nothing needed an excuse
Streetlights kept their little circles
Like they had no truth to prove

[Chorus]
Streetlights don't ask questions
They just turn the dark to gold
They don't care what broke behind you
They don't need the story told
Streetlights don't ask questions
They just wait along the way
Maybe that's enough for midnight
Maybe that's enough to stay

[Verse 2]
Quiet houses, empty corners
Traffic lights changing for no one
Somewhere far a train keeps moving
Like it knows what it has done

[Bridge]
No confession
No reply
Just another road beneath the sky

[Final Chorus]
Streetlights don't ask questions
They just turn the dark to gold
They don't care what broke behind you
They don't need the story told
Streetlights don't ask questions
They just wait along the way
Maybe that's enough for midnight
Maybe that's enough to stay
